_note: Trainer settings (camelCase = buildArgs args, UPPER_CASE = training_config.json keys, as in node/sweep.mjs --set) tuned on MNIST 28x28 test digits: always growing from 1 site, λ 0 so runs end at their budget, 1000 iterations, L1 loss, by mean final PSNR over 20 digits (2 per class) at budgets of 8 and 32 sites. A ~10 min coordinate search from presets/kodak.json over growth schedule, growth LR decay, LR multiplier / position LR and LR schedule; runs vary by about ±0.25 dB. On 20 held-out digits: 20.97 dB vs 16.36 dB for the Kodak settings (both L1). λ 400 (the Kodak value) stops growth at ~2.5 sites on 28x28, since a site costs 128 bits = 0.16 bpp; at a 32-site cap λ 25 ends at ~29 sites for -1 dB. A second ~10 min search over color space and the six base LRs (×0.5 / ×2, two passes) moved colorSpace rgb -> logchroma (+1.2 dB on the tuning digits) and lrColorBase 0.01 -> 0.005; held out: 21.49 vs 21.07 dB. lrPosBase 0.2 scored +0.06 dB (under the 0.15 dB bar), the rest within noise. Not tuned: τ / radius init, candidate settings. Hand-set afterwards (not from a sweep): growEvery 5 -> 50, growLrDecay 1 -> 0.5, logFreq (refresh every) 5. Then a 48-setting grid over lrMult {1,2,4} × growLrDecay {1,0.7,0.5,0.3} × growEvery {10,25,50,100} (same tuning digits and budgets) picked lrMult 4, growLrDecay 0.5, growEvery 10: 20.27 dB vs 18.81 dB for the hand-set values. growEvery mattered most (100 → 10: +1.9 dB averaged over the rest); lrMult 2 and 4 were within noise of each other, 1 was worse; growLrDecay 0.3 was worse, 0.5–1 within noise.
